method: relocated-angle astrocartography; hit = natal planet within 4.0 deg of a relocated angle, scored only at orb <= 3.0 deg; per-hit = planet weight x angle weight x (1.25 - orb/5); combined = Ricardo + Julie
source: GeoNames cities15000, filtered to >= 100,000 (6,215 cities worldwide)
latitude_bias_check: flat: 0.67 (Ricardo) / 0.69 (Julie) scored hits per degree of longitude at every latitude 0-65N; raw totals are latitude-neutral
note: Every view here is the same verified scoring model as top25-verified.json, swept over the whole world instead of Europe. Cities are greedy-clustered at 45 km so a metro area reports once: the representative is the best-scoring member, `popk` is that member's own population (it alone must clear the 100k floor) and `metro_popk` is the cluster total.
